messages:
kai: Quick ask — can someone run a 32k long‑context throughput + p99 comparison H100 vs A100 vs L40S for the 7B quantized recipe? Batch sizes: 1,4,8. Need cold vs warm KV, ~1000 samples per config for p99. Meeting tomorrow so quick turnaround please.

maria: I can run H100 tonight in my reserved cluster. Need the exact script and model path.

devin: I can cover A100 and L40S tomorrow AM in perf pool. Quick q: q4_0 or q4_1? measure FP16 baseline too or just int8?

kai: Start with q4_0 (we saw fewer correctness diffs). Measure FP16+warmed-kv as baseline if you have capacity, otherwise int8 only. Use runtime/benchmarks/7b_quant.yaml as canonical config (linked in our docs). Also collect dmesg + nvidia-smi dmon. @bench-bot can you queue a baseline run for H100? :pray:

bench-bot: Queued job 4829 -> h100 | model=7b-q4_0 | ctx=32768 | batches=[1,4,8] | samples=1500 | seeds=[42,7] | ETA ~6h

sam: If bench-bot supports tags, tag this run `ship-meeting` so logs are kept. Also please upload raw csv to s3 after finish.

ops-bot: Noted. I'll reserve an L40S node with NVLINK disabled (we want a pure PCIe compare) and set isolated driver config. ETA ~2hr before L40S runs.

maria: Starting H100 now:
```
./bench/run_sweep.sh --model s3://redwood/models/7b-q4_0 --ctx 32768 \
  --batches 1,4,8 --samples 1500 --seeds 42,7 --out /tmp/h100-4829.csv
```
Logs: /tmp/h100-4829.log

maria: quick note — using warm-kv means we preload the prefix by running a short priming loop (`--prime 128`) before timed samples.

devin: For A100 I'll use the same command but add `--mem-alloc=large` and `--cuda-mem-guard=off` for long ctx. L40S run will follow ops-bot reservation.

devin: Also will try one run with q4_1 just in case — can we keep that as a separate job not blocking the main comparators?

kai: Yes, one extra q4_1 job is fine but label it `q4_1_explore`.

bench-bot: Job 4829 (H100) finished — uploading CSV to s3://perf-results/7b-longctx/4829/h100.csv

maria: Paste of quick summary (H100 job 4829):
```
SKU  | batch=1           | batch=4           | batch=8
H100 | 95 tok/s (p99 210ms) | 340 tok/s (p99 260ms) | 620 tok/s (p99 310ms)
```
CSV: s3://perf-results/7b-longctx/4829/h100.csv

maria: p99 stable for H100, tail looks clean. no OOMs, single minor kernel fallback in 2 samples (see log).

devin: A100 results (job 4831):
```
A100 | 88 tok/s (p99 420ms) | 320 tok/s (p99 480ms) | 580 tok/s (p99 520ms)
```
Notes: p99s are higher, saw repeated kernel fallback during small batch=1 hot path. collected `dmesg` and kernel logs -> uploaded to s3.

devin: L40S (job 4835, nvlink disabled):
```
L40S | 70 tok/s (p99 500ms) | 290 tok/s (p99 560ms) | 540 tok/s (p99 610ms)
```
Notes: L40S lower throughput vs H100; nvlink off slightly hurts batch=4/8. Also observed higher variance on p99.

maria: TL;DR — H100 is clear winner for longctx 32k on our q4_0 recipe. A100 shows a p99 regression we should dig into (kernel fallback). L40S needs nvlink re-tuning for better batch scaling.

kai: thanks. Can someone open a perf ticket for the A100 kernel fallback and tag `perf/regression`? Put the short logs and dmesg there.

devin: opened perf#792 -> https://github.com/redwood/perf/issues/792 with logs + a minimal repro. cc @eng-runtime

maria: small PR to runtime to add a pin that avoids the fallback on the hot path. @devin can you review? https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/887

devin: I'll review now, hope to merge today if tests pass.

sam: One ask for the meeting: can we get a 1-slide summary with the three-sku table + recommendation (H100 for prod, retune L40S, investigate A100 fallback)? I'll prepare and drop in the meeting notes.

kai: perfect. Thanks everyone — we'll ship H100 as default target for 32k longctx for now and follow up on perf#792 and L40S nvlink tuning. :white_check_mark:

maria: uploaded all csvs, logs, and nvidia-smi dmon traces to s3://perf-results/7b-longctx/4829-4835/ — ping me if you need direct access.

devin: quick follow-up — for future runs we should add `--trace-kernel` flag to bench so we capture kernel selection info. filing a tiny issue.

bench-bot: Tagging runs 4829,4831,4835 with `ship-meeting` and retaining logs for 30d.

kai: Great. End of thread — thanks again.
